title: The stag hunt
src: Jean-Jacques Rousseau, A Discourse on Inequality, 1755
idea: Two hunters can catch a stag only together, or each can safely catch a hare alone. Big wins need trust that the other will show up.
apply: For a shared goal, confirm commitment early and visibly, and make a small first move that builds trust.
remind: Big goals need trust. Show up first.
who: Ola and Ben, who want to launch an app together.

items.x: Stag: build the app together, big payoff
Hare: each takes a safe freelance gig
The stag needs both of them

scenes.nar: Ola and Ben could build an app together, which would pay off big, but only if both commit fully. Or each could take a safe freelance gig.

msgs.x: What if Ola takes a job?

scenes.nar: Each worries the other will flake. Both quietly take freelance gigs, the safe hare, and the big project never happens.

items.x: Say it out loud: I am in, fully
Both put the date in the calendar

scenes.nar: Rousseau's stag hunt shows that big wins need trust. They say it out loud, set a small first milestone, and book the date.
They ship the first milestone on time. Trust grows with each delivery, and both cut back their freelance work.
